Carleton University has a broad range of programs, research, laboratories, and equipment in Electrical and Computer Engineering at both the graduate and undergraduate levels. We are among the largest ECE programs in Canada. Read more about ECE at Carleton.
Electronics
The Department of Electronics offers a comprehensive range of rigorous, innovative programs. In fact, in some areas we are acknowledged as national and international leaders. You will also have the flexibility to choose the degree that suits you while challenging you to be your best. View the Department of Electronics website
Systems and Computer Engineering
One of the largest and most research intensive departments of Electrical and Computer Engineering in Canada, we are recognized as one of the world leaders in software engineering and computer systems engineering. View the Department of Systems and Computer Engineering website
